slides.headline: Check these *6 lines* before Black Friday
slides.sub: Shipping prices just hit a record. Most of the rise is carrier pricing, not fuel.

slides.title: Fuel surcharge
slides.body: Since 2021, 72 in 100 dollars of the increase came from carrier pricing, not diesel.
slides.cost: Check: the rate vs the carrier's table that week

slides.title: Home and area fees
slides.body: Extra charges for homes and remote zip codes. Business addresses get them too, by mistake.

slides.title: Address corrections
slides.body: A fee every time the carrier fixes an address. Some were never wrong.
slides.cost: Check: corrections vs addresses that changed

slides.title: Billed box size
slides.body: Big, light boxes are billed by size, not weight. 1 wrong box size repeats on every order.
slides.cost: Check: billed size vs the box you ship

slides.title: Storage and peak fees
slides.body: Your 3PL's peak rates should match your contract, starting on the right date.
slides.cost: Check: dates and rates vs the contract

slides.title: Double and late charges
slides.body: The same package billed twice, or months later. A brand just got a $200,000 back invoice.
slides.cost: Check: every tracking number billed once
